scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.test:skills: pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build && node tests/skills-service.test.mjs && node --test tests/operational-readiness.test.mjs && pnpm run test:operational-schema && pnpm run test:execution && pnpm run test:workflow
scripts.test:workflow: node --test tests/inbox-review-workflow.test.mjs tests/inbox-review-timer.test.mjs tests/mission-control-surface.test.mjs tests/dashboard-calendar-projects.test.mjs tests/kanban-finalisation.test.mjs tests/kanban-v2-operational.test.mjs tests/p0-agent-state-skills.test.mjs tests/agent-profile-manage.test.mjs tests/agent-profile-ui-hardening.test.mjs tests/worker-supervision.test.mjs && pnpm --filter ./scripts exec tsx --test ../tests/task-completion-policy.test.ts ../tests/autonomy-policy.test.ts ../tests/agent-employment-pack.test.ts ../tests/amanda-financial-controller.test.ts ../tests/model-policy.test.ts ../tests/ai-intelligence-analyst.test.ts
